27454-in-her-own-right.title: In Her Own Right
27454-in-her-own-right.creator: John Reed Scott
27454-in-her-own-right.description: A book by John Reed Scott. "And I'm thankful he did," Hungerford answered. "It saves me all trouble; I need never look at the stock report, don't you know; Government bonds are always the same.--I suppose it's a reflection on my ability, but that is of small consequence. I don't care what people think, so long as I have the income and no trouble. If I had control of my capital, I might have lost all of it with Royster & Axtell, who knows?"

arxiv-2003-00544.title: Exploiting Ergonomic Priors in Human-to-Robot Task Transfer
arxiv-2003-00544.creator: Jeevan Manavalan, Prabhakar Ray & Matthew Howard
arxiv-2003-00544.description: Abstract In recent years, there has been a booming shift in the development of versatile, autonomous robots by introducing means to intuitively teach robots task-oriented behaviour by demonstration. In this paper, a method based on programming by demonstration is proposed to learn null space policies from constrained motion data.

arxiv-2101-08099.title: Comparison results for solutions to p p -Laplace equations with Robin boundary conditions
arxiv-2101-08099.creator: Vincenzo Amato, Andrea Gentile, Alba Lia Masiello
arxiv-2101-08099.description: Abstract In the last decades comparison results of Talenti type for Elliptic Problems with Dirichlet boundary conditions have been widely investigated. In this paper, we generalize the results obtained in [ 3 ] to the case of p p -Laplace operator with Robin boundary conditions.

arxiv-2112-05823.title: A General “Power-of- d d ” Dispatching Framework for Heterogeneous Systems
arxiv-2112-05823.creator: Jazeem Abdul Jaleel, Sherwin Doroudi, Kristen Gardner, Alexander Wickeham
arxiv-2112-05823.description: Abstract Intelligent dispatching is crucial to obtaining low response times in large-scale systems. One common scalable dispatching paradigm is the “power-of- d d ,” in which the dispatcher queries d d servers at random and assigns the job to a server based only on the state of the queried servers.

arxiv-2206-09975.title: Distributions of gas and small and large grains in the LkH α ​ 330 \alpha\,330 disk trace a young planetary system Thanks: Based on observations performed with VLT/SPHERE under program ID 098.C-0760(B) and 100.C-0452(A).
arxiv-2206-09975.creator: P. Pinilla, M. Benisty, N. T. Kurtovic, J. Bae, R. Dong, Z. Zhu, S. Andrews, J. Carpenter, C. Ginski, J. Huang, A. Isella, L. Pérez, L. Ricci, G. Rosotti, M. Villenave, D. Wilner
arxiv-2206-09975.description: Abstract Planets that are forming around young stars are expected to leave clear imprints in the distribution of the gas and dust of their parental protoplanetary disks. In this paper, we present new scattered light and millimeter observations of the protoplanetary disk around LkH α ​ 330 \alpha\,330 , using SPHERE/VLT and ALMA, respectively.

arxiv-2210-17515.title: Beating ( 1 − 1 / e ) (1-1/e) -Approximation for Weighted Stochastic Matching
arxiv-2210-17515.creator: Mahsa Derakhshan, Alireza Farhadi
arxiv-2210-17515.description: Abstract In the stochastic weighted matching problem, the goal is to find a large-weight matching of a graph when we are uncertain about the existence of its edges. In particular, each edge e has a known weight w_{e} but is realized independently with some probability p_{e} . The algorithm may query an edge to see whether it is realized.

arxiv-2301-04956.title: Graph Laplacian for Semi-Supervised Learning
arxiv-2301-04956.creator: Or Streicher, Guy Gilboa
arxiv-2301-04956.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning is highly useful in common scenarios where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. The graph (or nonlocal) Laplacian is a fundamental smoothing operator for solving various learning tasks. For unsupervised clustering, a spectral embedding is often used, based on graph-Laplacian eigenvectors.

arxiv-2311-04018.title: Quantum reaction-limited reaction-diffusion dynamics of noninteracting Bose gases
arxiv-2311-04018.creator: Shiphrah Rowlands, Igor Lesanovsky, Gabriele Perfetto
arxiv-2311-04018.description: Abstract We investigate quantum reaction-diffusion systems in one-dimension with bosonic particles that coherently hop in a lattice, and when brought in range react dissipatively. Such reactions involve binary annihilation ( A + A → ∅ A+A\to\emptyset ) and coagulation ( A + A → A A+A\to A ) of particles at distance d d .

arxiv-2311-18011.title: Anomalies in Hadronic 𝑩 B Decays
arxiv-2311-18011.creator: Raphaël Berthiaume, Bhubanjyoti Bhattacharya, Rida Boumris, Alexandre Jean, Suman Kumbhakar, David London
arxiv-2311-18011.description: Abstract In this paper, we perform fits to B → P ​ P B\to PP decays, where B = { B 0 , B + , B s 0 } B=\{B^{0},B^{+},B_{s}^{0}\} and the pseudoscalar P = { π , K } P=\{\pi,K\} , under the assumption of flavor SU(3) symmetry [SU(3) F ].

arxiv-2403-01297.title: Experimental Evaluation of the ETSI DCC Adaptive Approach and Related Algorithms
arxiv-2403-01297.creator: OSCAR AMADOR 1, IGNACIO SOTO 1 , MARIA CALDERÓN 1 , AND MANUEL URUEÑA 2
arxiv-2403-01297.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by OSCAR AMADOR 1, IGNACIO SOTO 1 , MARIA CALDERÓN 1 , AND MANUEL URUEÑA 2. Decentralized Congestion Control (DCC) mechanisms have been a core part of protocol stacks for vehicular networks since their inception and standardization. The ETSI ITS-G5 protocol stack for vehicular communications considers the usage of DCC not only in the network or access layers, but also as a part of the cross-layer architecture that influences how often messages are generated and transmitted.

arxiv-2403-08203.title: Learnable Community-Aware Transformer for Brain Connectome Analysis with Token Clustering
arxiv-2403-08203.creator: Yanting Yang, Beidi Zhao, Zhuohao Ni, Yize Zhao, Xiaoxiao Li(✉)
arxiv-2403-08203.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yanting Yang, Beidi Zhao, Zhuohao Ni, Yize Zhao, Xiaoxiao Li(✉). Neuroscientific research has revealed that the complex brain network can be organized into distinct functional communities, each characterized by a cohesive group of regions of interest (ROIs) with strong interconnections. These communities play a crucial role in comprehending the functional organization of the brain and its implications for neurological conditions, including Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and biological differences, such as in gender.

arxiv-2408-02347.title: Improved Bounds for High-Dimensional Equivalence and Product Testing using Subcube Queries
arxiv-2408-02347.creator: Tomer Adar, Eldar Fischer, Amit Levi
arxiv-2408-02347.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tomer Adar, Eldar Fischer, Amit Levi. We study property testing in the subcube conditional model introduced by Bhattacharyya and Chakraborty (2017). We obtain the first equivalence test for n n -dimensional distributions that is quasi-linear in n n , improving the previously known O ~ ​ ( n 2 / ε 2 ) \tilde{O}(n^{2}/\varepsilon^{2}) query complexity bound to O ~ ​ ( n / ε 2 ) \tilde{O}(n/\varepsilon^{2}) . We extend this result to general finite alphabets with logarithmic cost in the alphabet size.

arxiv-2410-16486.title: Survival Multiarmed Bandits with Bootstrapping Methods
arxiv-2410-16486.creator: Peter Veroutis, Frédéric Godin
arxiv-2410-16486.description: Abstract The Multiarmed Bandits (MAB) problem has been extensively studied and has seen many practical applications in a variety of fields. The Survival Multiarmed Bandits (S-MAB) open problem is an extension which constrains an agent to a budget that is directly related to observed rewards.

arxiv-2604-10081.title: MatRes: Zero-Shot Test-Time Model Adaptation for Simultaneous Matching and Restoration
arxiv-2604-10081.creator: Kanggeon Lee, Soochahn Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

plos-pone-0002493.title: Hepatotoxin-Induced Changes in the Adult Murine Liver Promote MYC-Induced Tumorigenesis
plos-pone-0002493.creator: Shelly Beer, Kimberly Komatsubara, David I. Bellovin et al.
plos-pone-0002493.description: PLOS ONE research article. Overexpression of the human c-MYC (MYC) oncogene is one of the most frequently implicated events in the pathogenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Previously, we have shown in a conditional transgenic mouse model that MYC overexpression is restrained from inducing mitotic ce

plos-pone-0009827.title: Diversity in the Glucose Transporter-4 Gene ( SLC2A4 ) in Humans Reflects the Action of Natural Selection along the Old-World Primates Evolution
plos-pone-0009827.creator: Eduardo Tarazona-Santos, Cristina Fabbri, Meredith Yeager et al.
plos-pone-0009827.description: PLOS ONE research article. Glucose is an important source of energy for living organisms. In vertebrates it is ingested with the diet and transported into the cells by conserved mechanisms and molecules, such as the trans-membrane Glucose Transporters (GLUTs). pmc-10513184.title: Assessing of the use of proteins A, G, and chimeric protein AG to detect marine mammal immunoglobulins
pmc-10513184.creator: Michael Essien Sakyi, Takashi Kamio, Kaoru Kohyama, Md. Matiur Rahman, Kaori Shimizu, Ayaka Okada, Yasuo Inoshima
pmc-10513184.description: In recent years, there has been an increase in infectious diseases in marine mammals, including brucellosis, infections of morbillivirus, herpesvirus, and poxvirus. Several serological diagnostic methods, including enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays, immunofluorescence assays (ELISA), and western blotting, have been used to detect antibodies against pathogens in marine mammals.

pmc-10628158.title: Optimizing alpha-amylase from Bacillus amyloliquefaciens on bread waste for effective industrial wastewater treatment and textile desizing through response surface methodology
pmc-10628158.creator: Basma T Abd-Elhalim, Rawia F Gamal, Salwa M El-Sayed, Samah H Abu-Hussien
pmc-10628158.description: Food waste is a major issue, with one-third of food wasted yearly. This study aimed to produce sustainably the industrial enzyme alpha-amylase using discarded bread waste. Brown (BBW) and white bread waste (WBW) were tested as growth substrates using solid-state and submerged fermentation. The biosynthesized α- amylase is applied to treat starch-heavy industrial wastewater and for textile desizing.

pmc-11435472.title: Machine Learning-Based Gesture Recognition Glove: Design and Implementation
pmc-11435472.creator: Anna Filipowska, Wojciech Filipowski, Paweł Raif, Marcin Pieniążek, Julia Bodak, Piotr Ferst, Kamil Pilarski, Szymon Sieciński, Rafał Jan Doniec, Julia Mieszczanin, Emilia Skwarek, Katarzyna Bryzik, Maciej Henkel, Marcin Grzegorzek
pmc-11435472.description: In the evolving field of human–computer interaction (HCI), gesture recognition has emerged as a critical focus, with smart gloves equipped with sensors playing one of the most important roles. Despite the significance of dynamic gesture recognition, most research on data gloves has concentrated on static gestures, with only a small percentage addressing dynamic gestures or both.

pmc-11509326.title: Correlation Analysis of the Transcriptome and Gut Microbiota in Salmo trutta Resistance to Aeromonas salmonicida
pmc-11509326.creator: Shuaijie Sun, Jun Lv, Kuankuan Lei, Zhuangzhuang Wang, Wanliang Wang, Zhichao Li, Ming Li, Jianshe Zhou
pmc-11509326.description: Aeromonas salmonicida is a major pathogenic bacterium that poses a significant threat to salmonid fish. Yadong County, located in the Xizang Autonomous Region, is renowned for its characteristic industry of Salmo trutta aquaculture. In recent years, the outbreak of Bacterial Gill Disease (BGD) has led to substantial economic losses for S. trutta farmers. Our prior research identified A.

pmc-11690369.title: THE NEUTROPHIL-LYMPHOCYTE RATIO AND WHITE BLOOD CELL COUNT ASSOCIATE WITH MUSCLE ENERGETICS AND GAIT SPEED IN SOMMA
pmc-11690369.creator: Philip Kramer, Peggy Cawthon, Li-Yung Lui, Theodore DeConne, Nancy Lane, Xiaoyan Leng, Anne Newman, Stephen Kritchevsky
pmc-11690369.description: Systemic inflammation drives sarcopenia and cachexia, which impair the mobility and independence of older adults. We and others have demonstrated that muscle mitochondrial energetics are strongly associated with gait speed, leg power, and mobility limitations. However, the contribution of systemic inflammation to lower muscle mitochondrial energetics is not fully understood.

pmc-12613518.title: Cervical intradiscal pressure responses to end-range supine postures: a cadaveric investigation
pmc-12613518.creator: Marc T. Crawford, Jean-Michel Brismée, Marc-Olivier St-Pierre, Nicolas Bellot, Phillip S. Sizer, Stéphane Sobczak
pmc-12613518.description: BackgroundCadaveric studies suggest neck postures may affect cervical intradiscal pressure (CIDP) and potentially contribute to intervertebral disc (IVD) pathologies. Despite neck flexion and protraction posture prevalence and potential impact on cervical IVD health, no studies have investigated CIDP during end-range protraction and retraction.

pmc-13114436.title: A Three–Dimensional Ontological Formulation of Bohmian Mechanics
pmc-13114436.creator: Pablo P. Yepes
pmc-13114436.description: We present a three–dimensional field ontology for Bohmian mechanics in which the single-particle wave functions defined in ordinary physical space are taken as ontological elements alongside particle positions. In this view, each particle is associated with a wave function in three–dimensional space conditioned on the actual positions of the remaining particles.

pmc-13402458.title: Root-zone improvements in spinach through commercial biostimulants application vary among cultivars
pmc-13402458.creator: Md Noor E Azam Khan, Fahmida Fiza, Joseph Masabni, Genhua Niu
pmc-13402458.description: Improvements in root-zone conditions can potentially enhance shoot growth and are especially important in controlled environment systems, where maximizing yield within limited production space is essential. Commercial seaweed extract (SW) and humic acid-based biostimulants (HA) are widely used to improve root function and nutrient uptake; however, information regarding their effects through root-zone application in spinach (Spinacia oleracea L.

pmc-13601303.title: Exploring climate-related health risks and behaviors among vulnerable populations in the eastern Mediterranean: the cases of Jewish and Bedouin Negev desert residents
pmc-13601303.creator: Anat Rosenthal, Maya Negev, Matan E. Singer, Soha Natour, Irit Porat, Stav Shapira
pmc-13601303.description: IntroductionThe Negev region of Israel is susceptible to the impact of climate change, and future predictions include an increase in the intensity, length, and frequency of extreme weather events. The Negev is also home to a variety of vulnerable communities characterized by low socioeconomic status and inadequate availability of infrastructure as well as inadequate access to healthcare services.

pmc-13604814.title: The Flexible Peripheral Segments Modulate the Catalytic Activity of the FAD-Containing Monooxygenase EthA from Mycobacterium tuberculosis
pmc-13604814.creator: Dafeng Liu, Xieping Sun, Feng Yu, Hongying Song, Wenshuang Yao, Huashui Deng, Daoqi Song
pmc-13604814.description: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb), remains a major global health concern, particularly due to the emergence of drug-resistant strains. FAD-containing monooxygenase EthA activates the antitubercular prodrug ethionamide (ETH) in Mtb. However, the structural and functional mechanisms of Mtb EthA are not fully understood. Here, we report an AlphaFold2-predicted structural model of Mtb EthA, validated using Ramachandran analysis (91.

pmc-13626775.title: Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance in Europe: challenges and lessons from global practice
pmc-13626775.creator: Maria Qurashi, Maria Buti, Grace Lai-Hung Wong, Huma Qureshi, Masatoshi Kudo, Tawesak Tanwandee, Chien-Jen Chen, Ashraf Omar Abdelaziz, Mohamed AbdAllah, Jessica Howell, Vanessa Hebditch, Amit G. Singal, Peter Jepsen, Rohini Sharma
pmc-13626775.description: SummaryHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide and a public health concern, with 75% of cases considered preventable. Biannual liver ultrasound, with or without serum alpha-fetoprotein, is recommended as surveillance for patients at high risk of HCC.

uslaw-usc-t25-s5805.title: 25 U.S.C. § 5805 — Schools to business incubator pipeline
uslaw-usc-t25-s5805.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s5805.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 50 (Native American Business Incubators Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall facilitate the establishment of relationships between eligible applicants receiving funds through the program and educational institutions serving Native American communities, including tribal colleges and universities.
